x: John Quinlan, one of Jarlett's school, is now in the R.N. and stationed in Scotland. He wants to hear a few more items of sports news.
John Quinlan now transferred to the I.o.M. (not the M.o.I.) and is enjoying the sea breezes at Douglas, and learning all about many funny things.

Has been running well, beating the Junior Midlands Champion in a 10.1 secs. 100 yards at Nottingham. John Quinlan, now a R.N. telegraphist with Coastal Forces off the S. Coast, has been unable to do any running and now weighs 12½ stones.
